lines: Kumaraguru Madurakavi, Other Selling Shareholder, is due proceeds from selling 2,136,000 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹70.49 crore are scheduled for on or about Tuesday, November 3, 2026, per the offer timetable, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Retained shares of ₹81.07 crore (estimate, valued at offer price) are locked in for 6 months from allotment, meaning more value later.
Gain is unknown: average cost of acquisition is not confirmed from the documents.
